course: 1C:Enterprise 8 Programming — from foundations to professional development
title: Add a hint and preserve data: extension boundaries
goal: Design an original teaching extension and verify compatibility and disabling.

prerequisites.text: Complete P1–P11. Preserve accepted work, sources and a DT; distinguish common-module and application roles.

sections.title: Where the question starts
paragraphs: The infobase already contains 12 requests and 440 minutes. We need a units hint. Should one line require changing accepted source? Separate a small own module from the infobase and observe what disappears when it is disabled.

sections.title: Preserve accepted work and choose your own copy
paragraphs: First preserve accepted P11 work, sources and a DT. Run P12 in a separate new file infobase containing only the 12 invented requests. Initially transfer your metadata into a new empty infobase; never load a CF over prior work. Create the 30,45,15,0,60,20,25,35,40,50,55,65 dataset exactly once. If records already exist, do not repeat seed.

Data functions belong to own server common module УчебнаяИтоговая: Server/Server call enabled; Client/Global/Privileged disabled. Приложение.bsl belongs to the separate client application module. Preserve the prior handler and remove only the added call after the experiment. Neither delete nor duplicate old definitions.

КонтрольДанныхСервер.bsl adds ИтоговыйОпыт to your own server module. seed creates exactly one new dataset only in an empty control infobase; verify only checks it. Never repeat seed. The application checks the dataset using verify before showing the hint and labels.

sections.title: Changes have an owner
paragraphs: An extension develops a solution within defined boundaries without uncontrolled base edits. State borrowed objects and modified methods. Use an original course configuration, not a proprietary standard solution. Avoiding direct base edits does not eliminate risks to data or behavior.

Keep the base configuration, extension and data separate. Preserve accepted work and a DT. Restore the 12/440 control infobase into another directory. In Designer open Конфигурация → Расширения конфигурации → Добавить. Create your own УчебныйСовет; record version 0.1.0 and compatibility 8.3.27. Attach no third-party CFE.

sections.title: Complete source of the worked action
paragraphs: The worked experiment uses own extension УчебныйСовет version 0.1.0 and client common module Расш1_Совет. An explicit call returns the hint; no event hook is required. A server observer checks metadata presence; the application calls only the known literal Расш1_Совет.Подсказка(). No user-provided text is passed to Вычислить.
Files below belong to their respective modules. Source, loading and observation after running are separate stages.

sections.title: Compatibility is versioned
paragraphs: Bind the extension to exact base version, compatibility mode and source hash. Changes to borrowed methods can invalidate assumptions after an upgrade. Do not claim all-future compatibility. List accepted, rejected and untested combinations; similar build numbers do not transfer PASS.

The minimal worked experiment is an own client common module Расш1_Совет returning a minutes hint. Enable Client (managed application); disable Server, Server call, Global and Privileged. It adopts no fields and creates no extension-owned data. An adopted form command is a separate follow-up exercise, NOT RUN here.

sections.title: Your prediction before running
paragraphs: The hint disappears after disabling the extension. Does that establish that requests were preserved?

reveal.title: Check the reasoning
paragraphs: No. Missing behaviour and preserved data are different observations. Here the module disappeared from available metadata while all 12 records remained identical. This extension owns no data; the result does not generalise to arbitrary extensions.

sections.title: Data can outlive code
paragraphs: Disabling an extension changes behavior and can affect access to its data. Identify extension-owned fields and records first. Never test disabling on the only work. Preserve a backup, base-only version and an independent extended copy; test reenabling too.

Module Расш1_Совет contains exported function Подсказка(). Append СвойМодульДоступен() to own server common module УчебнаяИтоговая; keep the application caller in its separately preserved handler. The server checks metadata; the client executes the known call literal. Never pass user input to Вычислить. The hint calls no Записать.

sections.title: How state changes
paragraphs: The diagram’s 12/440 means 12 documents and 440 minutes. The hint does not call Записать. Comparing a complete snapshot after disabling checks a different property from an on-screen message.

sections.title: When a plausible result is wrong
paragraphs: The extension list shows version 0.1.0 and an active checkbox. That alone is not the expected hint. During preparation an event hook produced no observed hint; the working route uses an explicit client call. The hook cause was not established separately. The failed source is not the reference.

sections.title: Transfer changes are measurable
paragraphs: Add a simple workflow rule, such as priority validation, with positive/negative cases. Compare baseline behavior, disable on a copy and verify return. Declare original contributions and the base used: executing a package proves neither authorship nor distribution rights over others’code.

Export only your own extension as a separate CFE and XML/BSL. In the experimental copy clear only Активно for УчебныйСовет; leave SafeMode and dangerous-action protection unchanged. After reopening the observer reports no module. Compare all 12 records. Re-enabling and extensions with their own data need separate observations; deletion is not used here.

sections.title: A new independent task
paragraphs: In another separate copy, create your own hint version: «Один час содержит 60 минут; подсказка не записывает заявку» (one hour contains 60 minutes; this hint does not save a request). Preserve the previous version, CFE and XML/BSL separately. Show the new text, disable only your extension and compare all 12 records and fields. Check re-enabling separately. Do not change SafeMode or dangerous-action protection to match the example.
Preserve your attempt and prediction first. The reference is available on request and does not replace your work.
